text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's weakness is her sheer 
competitiveness. When challenged, she gets 
drawn into the duel, throwing off her pace 
and burning through her stamina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer suggests a new running style 
for her. Even if challenged, hold back to 
the absolute limit, and at the very end, 
unleash that pent-up fighting spirit into 
explosive speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian wins the mock race with her 
new running style. After the race, she 
felt no fatigue—only the burning fire 
within.
